title: Moderation zone edit form marks non-editable field
body:
Moderators have limited editing capability for moderation zones depending on creator/revoker role and zone status. This PR adds visual indicators showing which fields cannot be changed.
Changes:
- Controller: Added edit action computing @can_edit_name, @can_edit_reason, @can_edit_zone, @can_edit_period based on permissions and zone status
- Form: Name uses readonly, reason/period use disabled + hidden field for value preservation, map gets .content_map-disabled CSS class with error message
- CSS: Added .content_map-disabled, .readonly-field, .disabled-select styles
- Locale: Added zone_read_only translation

FIXES: #7389
